name: Sons
overview: Scripture reveals the preciousness of children as a heritage from the Lord, emphasizing the responsibility of parents to guide their sons in wisdom and righteousness. A wise son brings joy to his father, while folly brings grief to his mother, highlighting the relational dynamics between parents and children. The Bible also points to the ultimate Son, Jesus Christ, whose sacrificial love offers eternal life to all who believe. Furthermore, those who are led by God's Spirit are called His sons, signifying a spiritual adoption into God's family.
